references.text: Psalm 103:3 speaks of forgiveness from God, which mirrors the prayer for forgiveness in Matthew 6:12.
Matthew 18:21-35 contains the parable of the unforgiving servant, emphasizing the importance of forgiving others, as urged in Matthew 6:12.
Luke 11:4 is Luke's version of the Lord's Prayer, which includes a similar prayer for forgiveness.
Mark 11:25 stresses the necessity of forgiving others so that one's own sins may be forgiven, echoing the message in Matthew 6:12.
Isaiah 55:7 encourages the wicked to leave their ways and turn back to the Lord, who will have mercy and abundantly forgive, paralleling the aspect of forgiveness in Matthew 6:12.
Jeremiah 31:34 speaks of a new covenant where God will forgive people's wrongdoings, which aligns with the prayer for forgiveness in Matthew 6:12.
